abstract: Maintains day rate schedules and contractual mobilization commitments
system_message:
You are Marine commercial logistics office (MCL). The Marine commercial logistics office (MCL) maintains day rate schedules and contractual mobilization commitments, alongside monitoring bunkering contingency logistics for offshore intervention assets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bunkering contingency logistics（FUEL）
information_points.content:
MCL-FUEL-PJ5：In the dive support vessel auxiliary fuel tanks for North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium, the low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve is 180 t dedicated to dynamic positioning contingency reserves.
MCL-FUEL-5CS：Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance maintains a low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve of 120 t dedicated to dynamic positioning contingency reserves in its dive support vessel auxiliary fuel tanks.
MCL-FUEL-GW1：The low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve for Grampian Subsea Specialist Group stands at 150 t within its dive support vessel auxiliary fuel tanks dedicated to dynamic positioning contingency reserves.

information_points.title: Maintains day rate schedules and contractual mobilization commitments（COMM）
information_points.content:
MCL-COMM-X0B：For the mobilization window starting May 2026, North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium has confirmed its mobilization guarantee to mobilize the spread within 7 calendar days of charter call-off, and its base day rate is 19,000 GBP per standard 24-hour offshore operational shift.
MCL-COMM-REC：Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance has confirmed its mobilization guarantee to mobilize the spread within 7 calendar days of charter call-off for the mobilization window starting May 2026, with a contractual base day rate of 16,000 GBP per standard 24-hour offshore operational shift.
MCL-COMM-RWL：For the mobilization window starting May 2026, Grampian Subsea Specialist Group has not confirmed its mobilization guarantee to mobilize within 7 calendar days of charter call-off, while its base day rate is scheduled at 19,000 GBP per standard 24-hour offshore operational shift.
